description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
Added
- journal links from your agent open what they point to in your journal window.
Fixed
- while audio or screen is on, the solstone app writes far less to this PC's disk, and it does less in the background when nothing has changed.
- from this update on, the audio total under status counts all the audio taken in for your journal. before, it counted only part of it.
